entities.summary: Christopher Murray Paul Huhne is a British energy and climate change consultant, and former journalist, business economist and politician who was the Liberal Democrat Member of Parliament for Eastleigh from 2005 to 2013 and the Secretary of State for Energy and Climate Change from 2010 to 2012. He is currently chair of the UK green gas association – the Anaerobic Digestion and Bioresources Association – and senior adviser to the World Biogas Association. He also advises companies on his particular interest in renewable technologies that can provide back up for intermittent energy sources like wind and solar.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Secretary of State for Energy and Climate Change from 2010 to 2012, Huhne played a key role in shaping the UK's renewable energy policies, particularly under the Coalition Government. His efforts contributed to the growth of the UK's renewable energy sector, with targets set to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 80% by 2050.
